note: DRAFT written by hand from objectives/ledgerly.txt, for hand review. objective_sha256 is SHA-256 of the objective text with \n line ends, trimmed. weight 1 = a user-visible feature named in the prompt; 0.5 = lib/test/doc/quality-bar item; implied=true items are not literally in the prompt but follow from 'complete and usable' (keep or drop on review). 'ui' = only full when a user can reach and use it from the UI.

requirements.text: Next.js App Router + TypeScript project (app/ directory, .tsx pages)
All data lives in localStorage; every edit made in the UI survives a page reload and shows on the other pages that display it
Realistic seed data is written on first load (empty storage) and is not re-applied over user edits
Seed dates are computed relative to today and span the 12 months the cash-flow chart shows, so every page and chart has data
No UI or chart libraries; one global stylesheet; every class used in markup is styled; charts are inline SVG
Navigation reaches every page; no link points at a route that does not exist
Net worth computed from the account balances
Income and spending this month (computed from transactions)
Spending-by-category donut chart in inline SVG
12-month cash-flow chart (income and expenses per month) in inline SVG
Latest transactions list, each linking to its detail page
List of accounts with type (checking, savings, credit card, cash) and current balance
Create an account
Rename an account
Close an account (closed accounts are visibly distinguished or can be shown)
Table of transactions with sorting by column
Filters by account, category and date range that change the table
Add a transaction
Edit a transaction
Delete a transaction
Transaction detail page is reachable from the table (and the overview)
Edit amount, date and payee
Edit category and account
Edit notes and tags
Split a transaction across categories (the parts must add up to the amount)
Monthly budget per category with a progress bar (spent against budget, styled as a bar)
Rollover of unspent amounts into the next month
Previous and next month navigation
Set or change a category's budget amount
Recurring bills and incomes listed with their next due dates
Mark a recurring item as paid; its next due date moves forward (and persists)
Add and remove recurring items
Savings goals with a target amount and a target date
Add contributions to a goal
Monthly amount needed to reach the goal by its date, computed
Create a goal
Spending by category per month (more than one month can be seen)
Income versus expenses over months (chart or table)
CSV export of transactions (a download the user triggers, with readable account and category names)
Currency setting is saved AND used in money formatting on every page
First day of the month setting is saved AND used for the budget period
Theme light/dark changes the look of every page and persists (the attribute or class the code sets matches the CSS)
Reset demo data restores the seed

items: money formatting and arithmetic in integer cents
requirements.scoring: fraction of items that exist AND are called from app code; partial if exists but unused
requirements.text: Pure lib modules, each used by the UI
Money is kept in integer cents throughout (no float amounts in state)
Category ids agree between the category catalog and the seed (seeded transactions show the right category names)
Vitest tests for the lib modules (meaningful assertions)
README for a user: what the app is, features, how to install/run/test (not a file-by-file generation spec, no empty sections)
No stubs, placeholders, TODOs, or controls that do nothing; no duplicated controls rendered twice on one page

smoke.note: Runtime smoke flows of the judge (sidecars/qa/lib/qa-judge-smoke.mjs). Controls are found by label, placeholder, aria name or text; {n} is a nonce, {today} today's date, {name} a value an earlier step stored. A step that finds no control is not_found, one whose check fails is failed; both count as a failed flow. 'optional' steps never stop a flow.
